diff --git a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
index 38da1e6ecc..3950a3459f 100644
--- a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
+++ b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
@@ -125,6 +125,19 @@ class EnumSerializer(BaseSerializer):
     def serialize(self):
         enum_class = self.value.__class__
         module = enum_class.__module__
+        if issubclass(enum_class, enum.Flag) and self.value.name is None:
+            if hasattr(enum, "_decompose"):
+                members, _ = enum._decompose(enum_class, self.value)
+                members = reversed(members)
+            else:
+                members = list(self.value)
+            return (
+                " | ".join(
+                    "%s.%s[%r]" % (module, enum_class.__qualname__, member.name)
+                    for member in members
+                ),
+                {"import %s" % module},
+            )
         return (
             "%s.%s[%r]" % (module, enum_class.__qualname__, self.value.name),
             {"import %s" % module},
summary: EnumSerializer now serializes combined Flag values as ORed member expressions (e.g. re.RegexFlag['IGNORECASE'] | re.RegexFlag['UNICODE']) instead of using a None name.
